recent.text: Lombardi and Rodrigues will share the center duties vs STL. Both will take draws and will mix up positioning playing down low. “I think it insulates and supports Lombardi well that way,” #NJDevils HC Keefe said. Ammo is a natural C, too. Says he’s more comfortable there.
